notes.title: Update on new developments
notes.content:
Hello there,

Small update here: Since the last couple of months we have gathered a lot of feedback from our community setup on Discord. Based on the input of the community we have redesigned the game and will publish a new experimental branch tomorrow for testing purposes only. 

If you would like to help test the game out, feel free to join our Discord community and participate within the community developments!

So you will hear more from me tomorrow.

Kind regards,

Eric

notes.title: Small update on developments
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939822/07c8a2254c8c9c19685609e1b1e819cb670863a6.jpg
Hey all,

Just wanted to give you guys a small update:Upgrades:.

After gaining a massive amount of very positive feedback and great suggestions about the proposed gamemodel, Jacob and I started today with designing and implementing the new model! We do not know how long this will take since we have to change a lot like setting up new datamodels, change the UI logic etc. etc. but ofcourse we will keep you up-to-date. 

When we are ready we want to share this experimental branch with you guys to test it out!

We want to thank you guys graciously for all your extensive support and feedback. Without you guys we would never have come so far. There is still a long road before us, however, we truly believe that we can make this game really awesome together.

Happy flying:Spaceship_Ride:

Kind regards,

Eric

notes.title: Party! Evolvation 2.3 released
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939822/74b744dc6bbaaef52de3598dc2405fa1cb7bddd6.jpg
Bonjour les pilotes,

We have two huge features this release which were requested a lot by our community: Joystick support and support for several languages. Read below for a more in detail update.

Main features:
 * Joystick support (experimental)
- Still experimental, since we feel this still has to be tuned. Please test it and let us know your ideas on how to improve this further.
- Default bindings for Thrustmaster T-Flight Hotas included
- For other joysticks keybinds can be set in the options menu. If you like to get the keybinds for your Joystick added by default, please contact us on the Discord.
 * Localisation support
- Added support for French language (see options menu)
- Polish, Russian and Dutch translations are in progress
Improvements:
 * Improvement to sounds (engine and rocket trail make less noise, while flares are louder)
 * Improved 3rd person camera, it now moves more smooth.
 * On the scoreboard spaceship names are now displayed instead of "fighter 1" etc.
 * Menu now scales better (was required for localization support). There is still a lot to be done here (we are redesigning the UI)
- Bot strength increased
- And a lot of small other things
 
Bugfixes:
 * Fixed an issue for certain maps where other players were initially not visible and became visible after first respawn.
 * Fixed a bug with the support ship: lasers would sometimes bounce seemingly randomly when shooting.
 * Chat now properly scrolls down in case multiline text is added.
 * Fixed hosting of Free For All Matches
 * Negative count when flying outside of the level boundaries is now fixed
 * Bots no longer die at the end of a match
* And a lot of small other things
 

I would like to give a huge shoutout to all the people from the community that helped us for this release: For instance with the French translations (Colonel Mustard) and Extensive bugreports from a lot of people via the Discord Community (they keep us very busy :))
 

The community is currently working hard on further improvements of translations (Russian by  mrlol and Polish by  Blu') and a complete redesign of the UI (by CaptainLel). Next to those we are discussing a redesign of our current game model with a large group of people. If you like to help or join the discussions about Evolvation, join our discord: https://discord.gg/qWkaTGQ

With the kindest regards,

Eric Ruts

notes.title: Accidental revokes keys explanation, please view my updates here:
notes.content:
Note: Latest update last

First update after couple of minutes after accidental revoke:

Hi there!

The developer here. I am trying to rebrand the game, have a lot of updates ready etc. But a lot of games are being sold illegally. So i just tried the "ban keys options" but it was a mistake that also some activated keys got banned (Just happened). I want to make it up to you guys. Does anyone have a suggestion on how to fix it?

Honest mistake,

Eric

----

Update 10 minutes later:

- I have setup the mail: steamgiftskey@hyperreuts.com where you are able to request a key.
- I have asked Valve for new keys
-- I have asked Valve to undo the ban
- I will contact SG admin if they are able to sent new keys to the winners list, 
-- Already in contact with SG

I have developed this game together with one friend and invested nearly all our savings in this game. There is sadly no way that we have the capacity to get near the attention or players that is required for a multiplayer game, unlike the major publishers. With the new updates coming I hope to establish a player base so we are able to play together, which is the intend of the game.

That is also why I did give away 10.000 keys. In order to get a playerbase or people who would love to help an indie to reach some audience and just develop a fun game. It was very sad to see that a major amount was sold illegally. This sucked since our total revenue of our game in all time was never even larger than 100 dollars (Excluding taxes and cuts).

However, it a a quite good game besides there is no player base. That is why I am trying to re-brand the game. The first course of action was to ban the unused games which are being sold illegally. This actually had led to this forum in a couple of seconds. I am deeply sorry that I made a honest mistake and want to fix it immediately. I love the irony that nobody plays the game, however the moment I made a mistake I reach an audience bigger than I have ever got. Thank you all for responding this fast! This gives me the strength to develop further and make even more games, even though I make mistakes. 

Love,

Eric

----

Done everything I can for now:

- Contacted Valve and SG about the mistake of the ban of the keys
- I am waiting for a response for a fix. I asked steam to un-ban, made sure that SG knows that it was not your fault and you get un-banned
- In the meantime I work on redundant solves (if needed) such as asking Steam for keys to re-give and asking SG to re-give them

----
Update 04:13 GMT 1 October 2018:
- Valve denied my request of new keys without explanation. Requested again with better explanation...
- Evolvation is whitelisted on SG, this should solve the ban i guess? 

---

Update 19:05 GMT 1 October 2018:
- Still waiting on response of Steam. Request are being denied without explanation. I even requested to make the game completely free for a week so the problem can be solved. I am just an indie which is trying hard. In the mean time my company is getting ruined by getting negative reviews, hateful comments, and bad publicity by pressing (non intentionally) on a single button. I have created a lot new content and made a new marketing strategy for the game to start a new campaign in which I really believe it would work and which I communicated with Steam. It's a pity that the game and my company (and myself) is now being destroyed before I can even try. I doing everything I can.

Update 15:55 GMT 2 October 2018:
- In bellevue washington it is nearly 9 o clock (steam HQ). I hope they answer soon on all my requests.

Update: 21:54 GMT 2 October 2018:
- Steam just denied my keys again for redistribution
- I've asked them again to if they are not going to give the keys, that they can make the game for free for the upcoming period so everyone can add it to their library if they want.

Update 19:38 GMT 3 October 2018:
- Waiting on update from Steam.

Update: 8:00 GMT 4 October:
- Update from steam, not possible to undo the ban (as expected) but they are going to help explore other solutions. 

Update: 11:17 GMT 5 October:
- Waiting on response of Steam, I expect an answer and solution soon (hope today).

Update: 20:29 GMT 6 October:
Hi there,

I want to resupply everyone with new keys. But unfortunately, it seems that this is not going to happen since Valve denies the key request. When I did giveaway these 10.000 copies, Steam had a different policy for issuing keys. It now seems that they want to restrict supplying keys. https://www.polygon.com/2017/8/18/16167462/valve-steam-keys-limiting-developers

This is very annoying for me and for you. But within these limits I am trying to find a solution. And the fairest thing I can come up with is making the game temporarily free so people are able to add it to their library. so I've suggested this to Steam.

I am currently (again) waiting on a response of Steam. They are very slow in responding, and if responding, it is mostly not specific. I have now specifically requested to make the game temporarily free the next weekend so you are able to add the game to your library.

Hope this helps you. I am doing everything I can within (and out of) the limits and boundaries given to me.

With the kindest regards,

Eric

I've had contact with Steam and we decided to make the game temporarily free of now. So you are able to add it to your library. Hopes this helps you guys out and solves the issue. I am losing big time here, but I did this so the issue is being solved. I am sorry for the inconvenience. Feel free to add the game to your library!

notes.title: Development update: Tutorials, joystick support and many more
notes.content:
Hi there Pilots!

Hereby we would like to inform you with our current developments! We are working hard towards Evolvation 1.0.3. 

We have nearly finished our full joystick support, and steam controller support. When we release the new update, Evolvation is compatible with keyboard, mouse, Xbox controller, Steam controller and joystick (Hotas)! So everyone is able to play with their own controller preference!

We are also nearly done with the reconfigurable controls. The controls were reconfigurable, but contained some bugs. These are now fixed. For instance, configuring inverted controls is now quite easy. Besides that, presets for the controls are nearly done. Including the new controllers! At the new update, you will also be able to configure and save your own customized preset.

Currently, Evolvation is missing a tutorial. We have created some videos to give you a little head start, but now we are busy creating an extensive in-game tutorial. These tutorials aim to make you completely prepared for conquering the galaxy and you will be able to follow them at your own pace and select your own tutorial subject. For this tutorial, a special environment is developed with new shaders. View a preview of the test environment for the tutorials here:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25939822/29f8b76f68d3e6f02a61056dc076efd28466af18.jpg

We hope we informed you sufficiently with our development progress. Of course, a lot more is going on, and these points are just some of the highlights. 
Happy flying!

Kind regards,

Eric Ruts
On behalf of the HyperReuts team

notes.title: Release notes Evolvation 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi there pilots!

Check out this huge update!

New features/improvements 

AI released with many options including: 

Possibility to setup the difficulty of the AI (easy, medium, hard or auto) 
Different AI classes with random configurations for each AI 
The AI uses all possible in game actions such as flares, locking, boost and class abilities 
Each AI has a different and unique name 
The XP bonus and data bonus from AI’s depends on the difficulty of the AI 

Overhaul of the scoreboard at the end of the game to display the top players and give information about the next map 
Pickups now are attracted to the player when nearby to make it easier to take pickups 
The default key bind to chat has been changed from the C key to T key to prevent accidently entering the chat while playing 
Several presets for key binds are now provided to make it easier to change key binds for several standard configurations, including a mouse preset 
Several FX (special effects) improvements such as: The engine trail, distortion waves, explosions and level boundaries and much more! 
When leaving the level boundaries an green indicator named ‘map’ appears to guide the player back to the map 
Removed several unused features from the game to prevent confusion 
Map designs improvements such as: better spawn locations for team based gameplay and object placement 
New game mode: Capture the Hyperdrive! (The game mode works similar to the familiar game mode Capture the flag, but now in space!) 


Bug fixes 

You are now not able to join a game without configuration; the exception here is joining via invite, which requires going back to the menu. 
The number of remaining flares on a ship is now correctly shown and calculated 
The loading screen now always displays the correct map name 
Killing streaks now correctly resets when switching maps 
The countdown when flying out of the level bounds now shows the correct values 
If all sounds are disabled the engine sound is now correctly disabled as well 
Lighting distortion on some objects is fixed
Homing missiles are now correctly rotated in the direction they are flying 


Known issues
  
AI in capture the HyperDrive is not working correctly 
It is hard to understand the first steps of the game without a tutorial  
Crosshair is not the specific aim point for forward thrust in third person 
Mouse controls do not work as required  
At respawn, the game freezes sometimes on particular systems  
Start-up can take a couple of minutes with black screen.  This typically occurs only the first few times. 
In the hangar, some weapons go through the ground.  
Kill achievements do not work properly  
Focus issues in menu, such as the pop-up at first startup  
If a second screen is connected, resolution bugs can occur. This can result in no control of your spaceship. Workaround: Change resolution in game and apply settings.   
Switching teams in lobby is unclear and can result into bugs such as the same player present in both teams  
If chatting in the lobby, focus issues might appear.  
All servers in the server list have a ping of 9999  
The engine of the stealth ships are still in stealth mode after the stealth is finished.  
Class abilities stats are not present  
If an achievement is reached and the game is over, the achievement is shown behind the end-game screen.  
Collision problems, hitbox of spaceship seems incorrect in some cases. 
Sometimes after being eliminated, the locking indicator is still active  
Class ability of the Highspeed does not increase the max speed 
If the scoreboard is toggled to show while loading the next map it is impossible to hide the scoreboard (until the next game) 
 
 
What’s next? 
  
Clan support such as clan names  
  
You should be able to distinguish yourself as a member of a clan. Join games together, and enter tournaments. Add new members to your clan in a convenient clan hangar, and hang out together. It is more fun to play with friends!   
Joystick support  (Hotas)  
Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation.     
Maps   
More maps allow everyone to show out their skills and will challenge the player to adopt to the diverse environments.     
Spaceships   
We aim to develop more ships to let everyone pick one of their choice. It is undefined to which class the ships will belong.     
Gamemodes   
More gamemodes need to be created particularly to enhance multiplayer gameplay. The gamemodes should let all the maps and space ship abilities come together to make a challenging game.     
Matchmaking   
More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.     
Quickmatch   
Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable.     
Fairness indicator   
Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.     
Steam achievements   
Steam achievement incorporation will allow you and other players to keep track of your achievements.     
Dedicated servers    
Kick player from game   
Inactive players or those who are ruining the gameplay of Evolvation can be voted for to get kicked out of the match. Use and abuse of this function will be tracked to ensure the best gameplay possible.     
Voting system next map   
Players should have the freedom to skip a map.     
Linux build   
Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.     
Mouse control improvements   
Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.     
Steam controller support   
The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option.     
Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement.   
Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.     
Extra weapons   
A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.     
Stability improvements  
Achievements overview improvement   
The overview should be clear and structured     
Class abilities improvement   
It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.     
Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.  
Tutorial   
A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.     
Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.  
Improve the structure of the complete GUI 
Small single player mode  
Private team message   
Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy.      
Ability to select default configuration   
In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.     
Lobby redesign   
Improve the lobby design to be more intuitive and provide more settings such as switching teams.     
Server list redesign   
Improve the server list to include filters and make the list sortable  
Host screen redesign     
Improve menu background (Flying spaceships)   
The background should be more interesting and have a more personalised feeling     
In game stats menu improvements   
You should be able to quickly look up your statistics in a clear and concise overview   
    

Note: It is possible that some features, improvements, todos or bugs are missing. Please let us know if you miss something important!

We hope you enjoy this version!

notes.title: Evolvation 1.0.1 release notes
notes.content:
1.0.1. is released! This is our first version which is publicly available. Evolvation 1.0.1 is available on steam as an early access release. Early access does not mean a pre-order or an early access to the full game. Early access is a playable version of the game which is NOT finished. There are still known and unknown bugs, game modes missing, etc. At each update of the game, we will provide you with a list of release notes. In these release notes we want to state the new features, bug fixes, the known bugs in the current version and what is next in our development process.

Feel free to join the discussion, report bugs and suggest improvements.

Current state
Since this is our first public release we are not going to state the “new features” but explain the current state of the game. We will do this by stating the key features of the game in the current state.

Key features
•	Upgrading system 
•	Levelling system
•	In-game currency system 
•	Locking system 
•	Flares 
•	Movement system 
•	Spaceships classes 
•	Pick-ups 
•	Multiplayer 
•	Game Modes 
•	Low and high end system support 
•	Camera options 
•	Input support 
•	Level bounds 
•	Environmental damage 
•	Chat system 

Upgrading system
The player has the option to buy new spaceships, weapons, engines, computers and much more! You are able to configure your very own spaceship to your liking. Thousands of configurations are possible, so you can make your spaceship unique. But be aware, in order to buy an upgrade, you are required to have sufficient in-game currency. This currency can be acquired with several in game methods. 

Levelling system
Each player gains experience points while playing Evolvation. With these experience points, you can level up. If a player levels up, they can unlock spaceships, weapons, computers and/or other perks. A player can gain experience points with: 

•	Kill points: For each enemy kill you receive XP 
•	Assist points: : If you inflicted a certain amount of damage and someone else finishes. You will receive assist points. 
•	Game points: For game related activities such as: capturing a flag, defending a control point, destroying an enemy base etc. 
•	Completing achievements: Evolvation contains a lot of achievements which rewards the player for achieving them. 
•	Winning a game: For winning a game, a player gains experience 
•	Finishing a game: Players get a small reward for finishing a game

In-game currency system:
In the late future, the currency that we now take as granted, is no more. The evolving need of data in the future has become so important that is has become a currency. Gain data in Evolvation and buy and upgrade your spaceship with your collected data!

After taking the enemy out, a pick-up is dropped at the location of the enemy player which contains a certain amount of data. You are able to pick up this data. The data is in bytes. The data is divided into three categories: Terabytes, petabytes and exabytes. If you have collected 1000 terabytes, you will have 1 petabyte. If you have collected 1000 petabytes, you have one exabyte.

Locking system
The player is able to equip their spaceship with a primary and a secondary weapon. Most of the secondary weapons are equipped with a locking device. This locking system uses a homing missile projectile. The targeting process is as follows: 


1.	The distance between your spaceship and the target should be no more than a certain maximum 
2.	The locking indicator has to be in a certain radius of the target 
3.	The indicator moves to the target 
4.	When the locking indicator reaches the target, the target is locked 
5.	The warning indicator of the target shows: ”locked” 
6.	You are now able to fire a projectile as a “homing missile” 
7.	The homing missile will follow the target. 
8.	The target will receive a warning indicator: “Missile inbound” 
9.	Unless the target evades the missile properly, the homing missile will be a direct hit!

Flares
In order to evade a homing missile, some special manoeuvres can be executed. But the player has another option: Flares, sometimes known as “chaff”. Flares are an option to redirect an incoming homing projectile to another target. The new target will be the flare. If a homing projectile is in range of a flare, the missile prioritizes the flare above the original target. 

Movement system
All of the spaceships are equipped with our amazing flying control set. This control set gives the player the possibility to move in any direction. It is possible to make looping’s, roll over, rotating while still moving in the original direction etc. During our playtests we already saw some very interesting moves and we are really curious how the community will use our movement system to its fullest!

It sounds like a lot of options, and might seem very complex to learn. But all of our test cases resulted in one conclusion: The controls are very intuitive and easy to learn. For basic movement, it is not necessary to use all the degrees of movement, but it is nice to know that you can always fly more advanced! 

Spaceship classes
Everybody is unique and everybody wants to do something else. With our classes, you are able to choose what you want to do and what you want to be. Each class has its own special ability. 

•	Highspeed 
The ships in this class are extra small, very fast but extra vulnerable. The class ability is a special temporary boost in speed. 
•	Fighter 
The fighter is for the soldiers on the front-line. It can afflict high damage, has a proper hull for the defence and has a good speed. An overall good spaceship with balanced properties. The fighter has a temporary attack bonus.
•	Stealth 
The stealth ships are fast, hard to see and are very flexible in manoeuvrability. This class ability gives the player the power to have a temporary camouflage. 
•	Support 
Support ships have average stats. A bit more armour but are perfect for supporting your team. This class has more cargo space for supplies like: rockets, energy capsules, and health packs. Support ships have the ability to drop support packages for their team mates. If a team member picks one up, the supplier of the package receives XP. 
•	Tank 
A tank is much slower, has less manoeuvrability but has an amazing hull which gives the ship a good defence system. This class has the ability to spawn a temporary powershield around the ship, it increases the defence.

Pick-Ups
At the start of a game, each player starts with their default stats. During the game you can lose some of the stats such as ammo, health etc.. In the map, pick-ups are placed to regenerate these stats. The pick-ups are: 

•	Health Points pick-up 
This pick-up regenerates the health points of a player for certain amount. 
•	Energy Pick-ups 
This pick-up regenerates the energy points of a player for certain amount. 
•	Primary ammo Pick-up 
This pick-up fills up the ammunition of your primary weapon. 
•	Secondary Ammo Pick-up 
This pick-up fills up the ammunition of your secondary weapon. 
•	Data Pick-up 
A small amount of data will be added to the total data of the player. 
•	Support package 
This is the package dropped by a support ship. It refills the health points, energy, ammunition, and even a bit of data.

Multiplayer
An arena-like multiplayer space flying shooter which never stops to have action! It is a game which does not require extensive game hours in order to keep up with your friends. But still some amazing perks can be acquired by gaining experience points! Evolvation is an arena based multiplayer game like Unreal tournament, call of duty (multiplayer), Quake, etc. This means that a continuous player to player interaction is inevitable. Other players are the central game elements. 

Game Modes
Evolvation contains two game modes at the moment, we are aware that this is not much but we have quite some gamemodes planned for the final release. Please refer to the What’s next section to view our future plans: 

•	Free for All 
A gamemode wherein everybody is on their own. 
•	Team Deathmatch 
Team up! Work together to gain victory. 

Low and High-end system support
We aim to support low and high-end systems. We do not aim to compete with a space-simulator. Our goal is to let as much people as possible enjoy a fun and excellent graphical game. We do not want to rule a large group out by requiring very high system specs. When you have installed the game via Steam and press play, you can choose between 4 options:

•	Play direct X 11: This is a built for high-end devices. Your graphics card should support direct X 11. Heavier post processing effects such as bloom are applied in this build.
•	Play direct X 11 low-end: This is a built for devices which support direct X 11. Heavier post processing effects such as bloom are disabled. If you have a high-end system but the game does not respond well at the option above e.g. long loading times, joining lobby problems etc. Than this is the build for you!
•	Play direct X 10: This is a built for devices which support direct X 10 and not higher. Heavier post processing effects such as bloom are allowed in this build. Direct X 10 does not directly support some features such as refraction but your computer may be able to process it otherwise!
•	Play direct X 10 low-end: This is a built for low-end devices which support direct X 10 and not higher. Heavier post processing effects such as bloom are disabled. At start up your settings are set on low quality. Low settings on a low-end device will result in loss of graphics quality. Such as lighting problems in the My Hangar environment, textures are not loaded etc. These low settings are of really low graphics quality but it does not affect the gameplay, only the graphics.

Camera options
The player has several camera options. Some of the options are very different to play. The player can switch through:

•	Cockpit mode (First Person)
•	The camera is positioned within the cockpit of the spaceship.
•	Front-Cam
•	The camera is in the same position as it is in the cockpit mode but the cockpit is made invisible for a better overview.
•	Third Person cam
•	The camera follows the player with a spring arm.
•	Chase front camera
•	The camera is positioned up-front and is looking backwards. This gives the player the ability to view behind the spaceship. This is a good option if you want to check if a player is chasing you.
•	Fly-by camera
•	The camera chooses a point and focuses on you, which gives a cool “fly-by” effect. This fly-by camera is not a very good option to play well. But it gives a beautiful result!

Input support
We think it is very important that you can change the controls as you like it. That is why we have supplied this game with fully configurable controls. We support the use of mouse and keyboard, PlayStation controller (Mapped to Xbox controller) and Xbox controller. Please refer to the what’s next sections for our plans for joystick support!

Level bounds
On the edges of the map, level bounds are present. These are only visible if you are near the level bounds. These level bounds are present for deserters of the game. If you exceed these levels bounds, the player will receive a warning to return to the battlefield. If they do not return within ten seconds, they will be shot for deserting the battle.

Environment damage
Some of the maps contain high-energy or very hot areas. Be aware for this because they will inflict environmental damage.

Maps
In Evolvation version1.0.1 are 7 maps available. The maps:

•	Mothership: The mothership is under attack! A map where some bevels of the mothership can be a good evasive option.
•	Dying star: The massive fireball is the central game element in this map. A lot of evasive manoeuvres are possible. But be aware of the heat damage!
•	Spaceship graveyard: This massive spaceship was abandoned long ago. A lot of waste is flying around, it also seems that this graveyard is becoming a space garbage disposal. So watch out for the impact damage! In this map it is even possible to fly through the broken abandoned spaceship.
•	Satellite: This map is close to a planet. The complex build and several antennas of the satellite give the player a lot of manoeuvring ability between the structures.
•	Energy Station: the energy station is the central game element of this map. The energy station is draining all the energy of a planet. Be aware of the energy core, your shield cannot handle that much power!
•	Drainage: Four energy stations are draining a huge planet! This map gives the player the option to travel between the stations while hiding behind asteroids. But beware if you get off track, you will become a living decoy.
•	Pillars: A lot of space debris! A map where the vision is limited if you are going deeper in the gas. Debris chunks have formed beautiful pillars on the edge of the gas. A map where dog fighting is testing the abilities of the pilot. The pilot has the ability to manoeuvre through some holes in several pillars.

Spaceships
A total of 10 spaceships are present in this build. 2 for each class, 5 spaceships for below level 50 and 5 spaceships for level 50 and higher.

My hangar environment
An environment is present where you are able to buy and upgrade spaceships. This environment is called my hangar. You are also able to create, edit and delete a configuration of your spaceship. For instance, if you have bought multiple weapons for your spaceship, you can change the weapons here.

Achievements
You are able to gain achievements in Evolvation 1.0.1! If you have reached an achievement you gain experience points and data. The achievements are not yet integrated with steam achievements. These achievements can be viewed in the my hangar environment.

Join/Host
Evolvation is a multiplayer game. Currently there are no dedicated servers available, only for the database. So this means that you have to join a session which is hosted by another player. You are also able to host your own game by simply clicking on the host button.

It is possible to join games which are not started (In the lobby phase) or join games which are already running!

Because the game is running on steam you are able to right mouse click on a friend and invite them to play in your game! If a friend of is already in a game, you can right mouse click on your friend in the friends list and press join game!

Settings
You are able to change settings op the game in the options menu. Controls, Graphics and sounds. Controls are completely configurable, graphics can be set from low to high end and the sounds are divided into several groups.
Graphics settings are configurable in overall settings and custom settings.

Kill cam
When you are eliminated by the enemy, the camera goes to an overview mode of the location where you got eliminated and then points to the player which has eliminated you. The camera will follow this player until you got respawned.

Chat and voice system
You are able to chat in game with other player. The colour of the chat messages are defined by the player or team. You are also able to voice chat!



Bug fixes
•	Quite some! But these fixes are from closed testing only

Known bugs
•	Loading screen sometimes display the wrong map name
•	It is hard to understand the first steps of the game without a tutorial
•	Crosshair is not the specific aim point for forward thrust.
•	Mouse controls do not work as required
•	At respawn, the game freezes sometimes on particular systems
•	Start-up can take a couple of minutes with black screen. Mostly the first few times.
•	In the hangar, some weapons go through the ground.
•	Kill achievements do not work properly
•	Focus issues improvement e.g. start-up pop up
•	If a second screen is connected, resolution bugs can occur. This can result in no control of your spaceship. Workaround: Change resolution in game and apply settings.
•	In the server list, the friends, history and favourite tabs are not working
•	In the server list the filter buttons do not work
•	If all sounds are disables, the engine sound is still present.
•	Switching teams in lobby is unclear and can result into bugs such as the same player present in both teams
•	If chatting in the lobby, focus issues might appear.
•	All servers in the server list have a ping of 9999
•	The HUD displays Shield down and heat damage, they do not work and are not applicable 
•	You are able to join a game without a configuration
•	The engine of the stealth ships are still in stealth mode after the stealth is finished.
•	Class abilities stats are not present
•	If an achievement is reached and the game is over, the achievement is shown behind the end-game screen.
•	Collision problems, such being able to flying through certain objects.
•	Sometimes after being eliminated, the locking indicator is still active
•	Class ability of the Highspeed does not increase the max speed
•	Killing streaks are calculated throughout levels

What’s next
•	Clan support such as clan names
o	You should be able to distinguish yourself as a member of a clan. Join games together, and enter tournaments. Add new members to your clan in a convenient clan hangar, and hang out together. It is more fun to play with friends!
•	Joystick support
o	Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation. 
•	Maps
o	More maps allow everyone to show out their skills and will challenge the player to adopt to the diverse environments.
•	Spaceships
o	We aim to develop more ship to let everyone pick one of their choice. It is undefined to which class the ships will belong.
•	Gamemodes
o	More gamemodes need to be created particularly to enhance multiplayer gameplay. The gamemodes should let all the maps and space ship abilities come together to make a challenging game.
•	Matchmaking
o	More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.
•	Quickmatch
o	Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable. 
•	Fairness indicator
o	Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.
•	Steam achievements
o	Steam achievement incorporation will allow you and other players to keep track of your achievements.  
•	Dedicated servers
•	HUD improvements
o	There are some obsolete items such as the heat damage. 
•	Match summary screen
o	The summary screen should be a clear and informative overview
•	Control presets
o	We want to enable players to quickly switch between keyboard (and other controllers) pre-sets to find the setup that matches their needs. These can still be further tweaked in the customize control screen.
•	Kick player from game
o	Inactive players or those who are ruining the gameplay of Evolvation can be voted for to get kicked out of the match. Use and abuse of this function will be tracked to ensure the best gameplay possible.
•	Voting system next map
o	Players should have the freedom to skip a map.
•	Linux build
o	Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.
•	Mouse control improvements
o	Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.
•	Steam controller support
o	The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option. 
•	Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement.
o	Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.
•	Extra weapons
o	A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.
•	Level bounds improvement
o	The level bounds should be both distinguishable and unobtrusive
•	Stability improvements
o	Incremental stability improvements
•	Achievements overview improvement
o	The overview should be clear and structured
•	Map orientation indicator for when out of level bounds
o	It should be clear how to return to the map when out of level bounds
•	Class abilities improvement
o	It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.
•	Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.
•	Tutorial
o	A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.
•	Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.
o	Improve the structure of the complete GUI and HUD
•	AI bot
o	An AI bot enables to train or playing single player.
•	Small single player mode
•	Private team message
o	Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy. 
•	Magnetic pick-ups’
o	Make it easier to gain a pickup
•	Ability to select default configuration
o	In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.
•	Lobby redesign
o	Improve the lobby design to be more intuitive and provide more settings such as switching teams.
•	Server list redesign
o	Improve the server list to include filters and make the list sortable
•	Host screen redesign
•	Improve menu background (Flying spaceships)
o	The background should be more interesting and have a more personalised feeling
•	In game stats menu improvements
o	You should be able to quickly look up your statistics in a clear and concise overview
•	Particle effect optimization, better explosions!
o	We are constantly pushing to improve graphics such as explosions.

We will keep you up-to-date with our news flashes on our webpage, via our social media (Google+, Facebook, Twitter, linked in and if we release a video YouTube) and/or via our forum of Evolvation.

Feel free to join the discussion!

Kind regards,

The HyperReuts Team

•	Assist points: : If you inflicted a certain amount of damage and someone else finishes. You will receive assist points. 
•	Game points: For game related activities such as: capturing a flag, defending a control point, destroying an enemy base etc. 
•	Completing achievements: Evolvation contains a lot of achievements which rewards the player for achieving them.

Evolvation is a multiplayer game. Currently there are no dedicated servers available, only for the database. So this means that you have to join a session which is hosted by another player. You are also able to host your own game by simply clicking on the host button.

It is possible to join games which are not started (In the lobby phase) or join games which are already running!

Because the game is running on steam you are able to right mouse click on a friend and invite them to play in your game! If a friend of is already in a game, you can right mouse click on your friend in the friends list and press join game!

Settings
You are able to change settings op the game in the options menu. Controls, Graphics and sounds. Controls are completely configurable, graphics can be set from low to high end and the sounds are divided into several groups.
Graphics settings are configurable in overall settings and custom settings.

Kill cam
When you are eliminated by the enemy, the camera goes to an overview mode of the location where you got eliminated and then points to the player which has eliminated you. The camera will follow this player until you got respawned.

Chat and voice system
You are able to chat in game with other player. The colour of the chat messages are defined by the player or team. You are also able to voice chat!

What’s next
•	Clan support such as clan names
o	You should be able to distinguish yourself as a member of a clan. Join games together, and enter tournaments. Add new members to your clan in a convenient clan hangar, and hang out together. It is more fun to play with friends!
•	Joystick support
o	Everyone should be able to use the controller of their choice. A joystick will provide alternative controls, perfect for another gaming experience of Evolvation. 
•	Maps
o	More maps allow everyone to show out their skills and will challenge the player to adopt to the diverse environments.
•	Spaceships
o	We aim to develop more ship to let everyone pick one of their choice. It is undefined to which class the ships will belong.
•	Gamemodes
o	More gamemodes need to be created particularly to enhance multiplayer gameplay. The gamemodes should let all the maps and space ship abilities come together to make a challenging game.
•	Matchmaking
o	More control in the host screen will let you set up a match which has restrictions for the players that can join.
•	Quickmatch
o	Features such as automatic pooling should be implemented in the quickmatch, to let players land in games which are both challenging and enjoyable. 
•	Fairness indicator
o	Games in the serverlist should have an indication how experienced the players are to enable you to decide which game you want to join.
•	Steam achievements
o	Steam achievement incorporation will allow you and other players to keep track of your achievements.  
•	Dedicated servers
•	HUD improvements
o	There are some obsolete items such as the heat damage. 
•	Match summary screen
o	The summary screen should be a clear and informative overview
•	Control presets
o	We want to enable players to quickly switch between keyboard (and other controllers) pre-sets to find the setup that matches their needs. These can still be further tweaked in the customize control screen.
•	Kick player from game
o	Inactive players or those who are ruining the gameplay of Evolvation can be voted for to get kicked out of the match. Use and abuse of this function will be tracked to ensure the best gameplay possible.
•	Voting system next map
o	Players should have the freedom to skip a map.
•	Linux build
o	Extended support of more platforms will allow more people to play Evolvation.
•	Mouse control improvements
o	Currently Evolvation supports but is not optimized for mouse control. Improvements will make the mouse feel like a familiar and conventional addition to the game controls.
•	Steam controller support
o	The steam controller is not yet supported but we aim to provide this option. 
•	Customizable spaceships e.g. colour selection, decal placement.
o	Features such as customizable colours of your ship will make it distinguishable and to your liking.
•	Extra weapons
o	A range of weapons will allow you to pick a weapon that suits your playing style.
•	Level bounds improvement
o	The level bounds should be both distinguishable and unobtrusive
•	Stability improvements
o	Incremental stability improvements
•	Achievements overview improvement
o	The overview should be clear and structured
•	Map orientation indicator for when out of level bounds
o	It should be clear how to return to the map when out of level bounds
•	Class abilities improvement
o	It may be difficult to understand and use the class abilities to their maximum.
•	Stat balance improvement such as damage, health, bonuses from upgrades etc.
•	Tutorial
o	A clear tutorial is needed to introduce players to the game. Guiding players through the process of buying and configuring their first spaceship to let them started to get the most out of Evolvation.
•	Resolution improvements, some items are not aligned properly in the UI.
o	Improve the structure of the complete GUI and HUD
•	AI bot
o	An AI bot enables to train or playing single player.
•	Small single player mode
•	Private team message
o	Implement a private chat to discuss everything you don’t want to share with your enemy. 
•	Magnetic pick-ups’
o	Make it easier to gain a pickup
•	Ability to select default configuration
o	In the lobby or when joining in game the default configuration should be selected to provide a faster start of the game.
•	Lobby redesign
o	Improve the lobby design to be more intuitive and provide more settings such as switching teams.
•	Server list redesign
o	Improve the server list to include filters and make the list sortable
•	Host screen redesign
•	Improve menu background (Flying spaceships)
o	The background should be more interesting and have a more personalised feeling
•	In game stats menu improvements
o	You should be able to quickly look up your statistics in a clear and concise overview
•	Particle effect optimization, better explosions!
o	We are constantly pushing to improve graphics such as explosions.
